verdict.rationale: Appwrite's docs explicitly document email/password login secured with Argon2 hashing 'with just a few lines of code' and OAuth sign-in with 30+ providers including GitHub, Google, and Facebook, both delivered via the platform SDK. This directly matches the story's core ask of quick email/password and social OAuth integration. Missing for 10: independent hands-on developer confirmation of the actual time-to-integrate/setup experience beyond vendor docs.
